title: Pillars of the Community: Kathryn Mikesell, Founder of Fountainhead Arts - NewsBreak
text:
By Community Newspapers ,
1 days ago
On this episode of Pillars of the Community , hosted by Harry Gottlieb, we welcome Kathryn Mikesell , founder of Fountainhead Arts, for an engaging conversation on artist residencies, building community, and Miami’s growing role in the global art world. Established in 2008 and rooted in Morningside, Fountainhead has welcomed over 600 artists from more than 50 nations, immersing them in Miami’s art ecosystem and connecting them with curators, collectors, and the community.
“The art absolutely inspired us. But what kept us involved in the arts and what truly changed our lives was getting to know artists.”
“Everything in life is about connections… that’s the main thing that Fountainhead does — it makes connections and hopefully inspires people.”
In this episode, we discuss:
– The origins and mission of Fountainhead Arts
– The artist residency program and how artists are nominated
– Building community and connection in Miami
– Supporting artists’ careers and visibility
– The new Forum program and recent museum acquisitions
– Fountainhead’s upcoming move to Midtown and new curator and writer residencies
Don’t miss this inspiring conversation and stay tuned for future episodes celebrating the people who make our neighborhoods stronger.
